description: Georgia: Cobb County (FIPS 13067) tax assessor parcel and ownership data. Gated on purchase and terms. See docs/registry/sources/ga-cobb-assessor.md.

sources.publisher: Cobb County GIS and Cobb County Board of Tax Assessors
sources.gate: Purchase and terms. Cobb sells the Tax Assessor GIS parcel polygon data (published each August with the state-approved tax digest) and says 'Tabular Data (Ownership, Appraisal, Tax Bill, Etc.) available by request'; the GIS Data terms forbid sale, trade, sub-licensing and derivative works without written permission. The Tax Assessor's website (cobbassessor.org) returns 403 to the collector. Requires a person: request the tabular digest and written permission to republish facts from the Cobb Tax Assessor and Cobb GIS.
sources.license: Cobb County GIS data licence on the 'Get Data' page: GIS data 'are protected by United States copyright laws'; 'You may not loan, rent, lease, sub-license or pledge Cobb County GIS data'; 'You may not sell, trade, or bargain any computer files containing any of the GIS data'; 'You may not reverse engineer, decompile, disassemble, or create derivative works without the express written permission of the Cobb County Government'. Public records under the Georgia Open Records Act
sources.notes: No free parcel or ownership table found: the Cobb GIS Hub (geo-cobbcountyga.hub.arcgis.com, item f0b894fb12444f26a0925ff41daed8b8) lists roads, subdivisions, land lots, facilities and future land use, plus a Parcel Viewer web app, but no parcel download; the 'Get Data' page prices 'Tax Assessor GIS Parcel Polygon Data' (county parcels and subdivisions) in a '$54' to '$22,000' range depending on delivery. A City of Smyrna copy of the 2023 parcels (services2.arcgis.com/hE9igMm8RoNeQRbh/arcgis/rest/services/Cobb_Parcels/FeatureServer) exists but is third-party and was not reviewed. robots.txt: geo-cobbcountyga.hub.arcgis.com Crawl-delay 60; gis.cobbcounty.gov has none (404); www.cobbassessor.org serves Cloudflare content signals and answered 403 to the collector.
